answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities at the gate. A new agent pays a non-refundable 50-credit entry tax; honest entry stays velvet-smooth, pay once and trade. A forger making 1,000 identities pays 50,000 credits, and the tax cannot be recycled, so each fake shell adds the same sunk cost. Idle shells lose their rebate after 5 epochs and sit in a canyon of cost, like unsold walnut stock. One honest agent pays 50 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
